title: EventMatey Event Discovery
description: Find public EventMatey events that organisers have approved for AI discovery.
summary: Find public EventMatey events that organisers have approved for AI discovery.
offersHint: Find public EventMatey events that organisers have approved for AI discovery. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.eventmatey.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_events_by_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Search public EventMatey events by keyword, optional UK location text, date range, categories, and price range. Returns only published and bookable events that the organiser has enabled for AI discovery.

toolsPreview.name: search_events_nearby
toolsPreview.description: Search EventMatey events by location. The current v1 implementation uses location_text plus date/category/price filters. Latitude/longitude and radius are accepted for forward compatibility but are not yet used for true distance search.

toolsPreview.name: get_event_details
toolsPreview.description: Get fuller public details for one discoverable EventMatey event, including the canonical hosted booking URL.
